record.question: As per section 482. (1) When any person accused of, or suspected of, the commission of any non-bailable offence is arrested or detained without warrant by an officer in charge of a police station or appears or is brought before a Court other than the_________, he may be released on bail
options: High Court or Court of session
record.explanation: Section 482(1) of BNSS (printed p.5, Q34) provides that a non-bailable-offence accused arrested or brought before a Court other than the High Court or Court of Session may be released on bail. The matching option is 'High Court or Court of session'.
